title: The Treaty of Waitangi is first signed
summary: Māori chiefs and representatives of the British Crown first signed the Treaty of Waitangi on 6 February 1840. Further signatures were collected around New Zealand.

claims.text: Māori chiefs and representatives of the British Crown first signed the Treaty of Waitangi on 6 February 1840. Further signatures were collected around New Zealand.
First signing, not every later signature.
The Māori and English texts differ in meaning. A signing date alone cannot resolve debates about authority, sovereignty and the treaty’s subsequent interpretation.
